Design:

```go
package godump

import (
	"io"
	"os"

	"github.com/davecgh/go-spew/spew"
)

type Dumper struct {
	cfg *spew.ConfigState
}

func New() *Dumper {
	cfg := spew.NewDefaultConfig()
	cfg.DisableMethods = false
	cfg.DisablePointerAddresses = false
	cfg.DisableCapacities = true
	cfg.SortKeys = true
	cfg.SpewKeys = true
	cfg.MaxDepth = 0
	cfg.Indent = "  "
	cfg.ContinueOnMethod = false
	cfg.DisablePointerMethods = false
	return &Dumper{cfg: cfg}
}

func (d *Dumper) Dump(v any, args ...any) {
	d.cfg.Dump(v, args...)
}

func (d *Dumper) Sdump(v any, args ...any) string {
	return d.cfg.Sdump(v, args...)
}

func (d *Dumper) Fdump(w io.Writer, v any, args ...any) error {
	return d.cfg.Fdump(w, v, args...)
}
```
